$comment: Every Eduport logo file in svg/. `use` says where each one belongs; the gallery and docs are generated from this list.

logos.name: wordmark-orange
logos.title: Wordmark, orange
logos.use: The primary logo. Use it whenever the background is white or a light neutral: app and website headers, sign-in screens, emails, documents and slides.

logos.name: wordmark-white
logos.title: Wordmark, white
logos.use: On brand orange, dark surfaces (dark theme headers) and dark photos or video. Check the background behind it is dark enough to read the cap and tassel.

logos.name: wordmark-black
logos.title: Wordmark, black
logos.use: One-color reproduction only: black-and-white print, stamps, engraving and embossing, fax, and partner lockups that require a mono logo.

logos.name: symbol-orange
logos.title: Symbol, orange
logos.use: The cap-and-e mark alone, for tight spaces where Eduport is already named nearby: a collapsed sidebar, a loading screen, a watermark.

logos.name: symbol-white
logos.title: Symbol, white
logos.use: The symbol on brand orange or dark surfaces, for the same tight spaces as the orange symbol.

logos.name: symbol-tile-brand
logos.title: App icon, orange
logos.use: The default app icon: iOS and Android launcher icons, PWA manifest icons, favicons, and app store listings.

logos.name: symbol-tile-light
logos.title: App icon, white
logos.use: Alternate app icon for orange or dark backgrounds where the orange tile would disappear, such as a tile on a brand-colored page or a dark-mode home screen preview.

logos.name: symbol-circle-brand
logos.title: Round icon, orange
logos.use: Eduport as the sender inside a product: the avatar on system messages, notifications, comments and chat, and map pins.

logos.name: symbol-circle-light
logos.title: Round icon, white
logos.use: The round icon on orange or dark backgrounds, for example a system avatar inside an orange banner.

logos.name: wordmark-tile-brand
logos.title: Wordmark tile, orange
logos.use: Square spaces big enough to read the name: default cover images for courses and videos, square ads, social post templates and end cards.

logos.name: wordmark-tile-light
logos.title: Wordmark tile, white
logos.use: The wordmark tile on orange or dark backgrounds, or where a lighter placeholder image reads better.

logos.name: symbol-avatar-brand
logos.title: Social avatar, symbol
logos.use: Profile pictures on platforms that crop to a circle and show them small: WhatsApp, YouTube, Instagram, X. The extra padding keeps the mark inside the circle.

logos.name: wordmark-avatar-brand
logos.title: Social avatar, wordmark
logos.use: Profile pictures shown large enough to read the name, such as a LinkedIn or Facebook page. Safe for circular crops.

logos.name: wordmark-card-light-lg
logos.title: White card, large mark
logos.use: Places the logo on photos, colored or busy backgrounds where it needs its own plate. Use the large mark when the card is shown small, such as a partner logo strip or a sponsor row.

logos.name: wordmark-card-light-md
logos.title: White card, medium mark
logos.use: The same white card at mid size, such as a logo on an event banner or certificate.

logos.name: wordmark-card-light-sm
logos.title: White card, small mark
logos.use: The white card shown large, where the generous padding reads as breathing room: a hero banner or a printed backdrop.

logos.name: wordmark-card-brand-lg
logos.title: Orange card, large mark
logos.use: A solid brand block on white, neutral or dark backgrounds. Use the large mark when the card is shown small, such as an email header or a footer.

logos.name: wordmark-card-brand-md
logos.title: Orange card, medium mark
logos.use: The orange card at mid size, such as a presentation title slide or a web banner.

logos.name: wordmark-card-brand-sm
logos.title: Orange card, small mark
logos.use: The orange card shown large, where the padding reads as breathing room: a hero, a stage screen or a printed backdrop.

logos.name: wordmark-pill-light
logos.title: White pill
logos.use: A floating badge over photos and video, a 'powered by Eduport' mark on partner pages, and stickers or merchandise.

logos.name: wordmark-pill-brand
logos.title: Orange pill
logos.use: The pill on white or neutral backgrounds, for the same badge, sticker and co-branding uses.

logos.name: wordmark-tab-brand
logos.title: Orange tab
logos.use: Hangs from the top edge of a page: landing page headers, letterheads, certificates and slide masters. Align its flat top edge with the edge of the page.

logos.name: wordmark-tab-light
logos.title: White tab
logos.use: The hanging tab on orange, dark or photo backgrounds.

logos.name: wordmark-tab-angled-brand
logos.title: Orange angled tab
logos.use: A more expressive hanging tab for marketing: posters, social graphics, event banners and campaign pages. Keep it out of product UI.

logos.name: wordmark-tab-angled-light
logos.title: White angled tab
logos.use: The angled tab on orange, dark or photo backgrounds, for the same marketing uses.
